title: How to run this gate
steps: Run it on the laptop you're bringing Monday
Start from a freshly opened terminal
Have your setup log open beside you

title: A · Foundations
steps: Windows 11, 64-bit, not ARM
Git, Node, and Python all answer
Git Bash exists at a path you know
Script execution is allowed, and not overridden
"python" is the real Python

title: B · Your three keys
steps: All three keys are saved for your account
Your keys still have room to spend

title: C · Four required agents — files on disk
steps: Clear the old proof files and regenerate them
Codex wrote from-codex.txt
OpenCode wrote from-opencode.txt
Pi wrote from-pi.txt, and can reach a shell
goose wrote from-goose.txt
All four files present together, seen in Explorer
Optional: Claude Code file, if you installed it

title: D · Supporting tools
steps: Obsidian opens your vault
n8n starts, serves, and stops
Course repo present and site serves

title: E · Operator readiness
steps: Operator templates are in your working project
You can state the twin-engine pair
You know what to do if a key leaks
Your setup log holds at least one real failure and fix

title: Gate result
steps: Declare your colour honestly
Record the details that identify this run
Pack for Monday
